biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was the son of renowned architect Selba Brondel. Selba created many famed buildings, such as Heilingham Palace, also known as the Hanging Gardens. Orba taught at the Coritanae Academy of Arts while painting numerous works in his spare time. One of these, named "Opalescent Clouds," was presented to the late King Dorgalua, and now hangs in Heim Castle.
  Orba was a major proponent of the nationalism espoused by Hierophant Balbatos, and he volunteered to take up arms soon after war broke out.
  He encountered Resistance forces at Tynemouth while en route to Almorica, and was slain by {hero} Pavel.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era hijo del renombrado arquitecto Selba Brondel. Selba creo varios edificios famosos, como el Palacio de Heilingham, conocido como los Jardines Colgantes. Orba dio clases en la Academia de Artes de Coritanae mientras pintaba en su tiempo libre. Una obra, "Nubes opalescentes", fue entregada al difunto rey Dorgalua y cuelga en el Castillo de Heim.
  Gran defensor del nacionalismo del jerarca Balbatos, fue voluntario tras estallar la guerra.
  Camino a Almorica, topo con la Resistencia en Tynemouth y fue abatido por {hero} Pavel.

biography_english:
A Walister who served the New Walister Alliance. Gousin wanted to fight for his people, but his poor upbringing led to him resenting nobility, and he was hesitant to join the Resistance with Duke Ronwey at the helm. He later learned that the New Walister Alliance also sought self-governance for the Walister, and resolved to join them.
  Gousin was a devout follower of the Order of Philaha, which preaches that all are equal in the eyes of the Great Father. He prayed before each battle and at dusk each day, earning him the moniker "Gousin the Devout" among his fellow soldiers.
  While en route to Almorica to rally like-minded soldiers to the cause, he was killed by {hero} on the Golborza Plain. It seemed he had heard a great deal of {hero}'s sister, Catiua.
biography_spanish:
Un walister que sirvio a la Nueva Alianza Walister. Gousin queria luchar por su pueblo, pero su humilde origen lo llevo a resentir a la nobleza, y vacilaba en unirse a la Resistencia con el duque Ronwey al frente. Mas tarde supo que la Nueva Alianza Walister tambien buscaba el autogobierno para los walister, y decidio unirse a ellos.
  Gousin era un devoto seguidor de la Orden de Philaha, que predica que todos son iguales ante el Gran Padre. Rezaba antes de cada batalla y al anochecer cada dia, ganandose el apodo de "Gousin el Devoto" entre sus camaradas.
  Camino a Almorica para convocar soldados afines a la causa, fue abatido por {hero} en la planicie de Golborza. Parecia haber oido hablar mucho de Catiua, la hermana de {hero}.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was the son of renowned architect Selba Brondel. His twin brother Orba was slain by {hero} at Tynemouth.
  Garba had won fame as a political philosopher, penning works such as "The Creed of the Self-Deceived" and "Failings of Present-Day Doctrine." Though initially an advocate of progressive politics, he took a more nationalistic tone after hearing the words of Hierophant Balbatos. He stated in one address, "Nothing can assuage the resentment we harbor toward the Walister, though we may know it unjust." The way he calmly vanquished his opponents in argument earned him the name "Garba the Silver-Tongued."
  He was slain by {hero} Pavel on the Xeod Moors while marching to engage Resistance forces at Balmamusa.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era hijo del renombrado arquitecto Selba Brondel. Su hermano gemelo Orba fue abatido por {hero} en Tynemouth.
  Garba gano fama como filosofo politico, autor de obras como "El credo de los ilusos" y "Fallos de la doctrina actual". Aunque al principio defendia ideas progresistas, adopto un tono mas nacionalista tras oir al jerarca Balbatos. Afirmo en un discurso: "Nada puede calmar el rencor que guardamos a los walister, aun sabiendo que es injusto". Su calma al vencer rivales en debate le valio el apodo "Garba Pico de Plata".
  Fue abatido por {hero} Pavel en los paramos de Xeod cuando marchaba a luchar contra la Resistencia en Balmamusa.

biography_english: A Galgastani who serves his clan in battle. He is a close associate of Hierophant Balbatos, and one of his most trusted commanders. He also played a large role in carrying out the blood war. He openly states his opinion that the Galgastani are superior to other peoples, and is particularly savage towards non-Galgastani on the field of battle. He will slay any opponent of the current regime without mercy, and is called "Bloodletter" as a result.
biography_spanish: Un galgastani que sirve a su clan en batalla. Es allegado del jerarca Balbatos y uno de sus comandantes de mas confianza. Tambien tuvo un gran papel en la guerra sanguinaria. Abate sin piedad a cualquier rival del regimen actual, por lo que lo llaman "el Sanguinario".

biography_english:
A Bakram who served his clan in battle. He was the eldest son of House Grandier, a noble family of renown in Barnicia. He led the castle guard at Heim.
  House Grandier traces its lineage back to Lord Clemont of Barnicia, and many have held official posts over the generations. They also served as knights to King Dorgalua, and now hold sway in both military and civil matters.
  Latimer had frequented Heim Castle as a squire since his youth, seeking to hone his skills and become an exemplary knight. He was an accomplished man-at-arms and commander, well-liked by both his men and the people of Heim for his gallantry.
  These qualities led to him being charged with the defense of Heim Castle. He was killed fighting the Order of {order}.
biography_spanish:
Un bakram que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era el hijo mayor de la Casa Grandier, una noble familia de renombre en Barnicia. Lideraba la guardia del castillo de Heim.
  La Casa Grandier remonta su linaje a lord Clemont de Barnicia, y muchos han ocupado cargos oficiales por generaciones. Tambien sirvieron como caballeros al rey Dorgalua, y ahora influyen en asuntos militares y civiles.
  Latimer acudia al Castillo de Heim como escudero desde su juventud, buscando pulir sus dotes y ser un caballero ejemplar. Era un experto combatiente y comandante, muy apreciado por sus hombres y la gente de Heim por su gallardia.
  Esas cualidades llevaron a encomendarle la defensa del Castillo de Heim. Murio luchando contra la Orden de {order}.

biography_english:
A guardian of the Palace of the Dead. The statues lining the halls of the palace are actually unlucky explorers turned to stone by her magic.
  Xadoba was hideously disfigured in her true form, but was said to appear as a beautiful maiden before visitors to the palace. Those who inhabit the realm of chaos are adept at manipulating mortal minds, and can bend them to their will with ease.
  Xadoba was defeated by {hero} after attempting to prevent his passage through the palace.
biography_spanish:
Una guardiana del Palacio de los Muertos. Las estatuas que llenan los pasillos son exploradores desafortunados convertidos en piedra por su magia.
  Xadoba estaba horriblemente desfigurada en su forma real, pero decian que aparecia como una bella doncella ante los visitantes del palacio. Quienes habitan el reino del caos son diestros manipulando mentes mortales y las doblegan con facilidad.
  Xadoba fue derrotada por {hero} tras intentar impedir su paso por el palacio.
